title: Database Systems
content: A database is an organized collection of structured information or data stored electronically. Database management systems such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB allow users to create, read, update, and delete data efficiently. Relational databases organize data into tables with rows and columns linked by keys. NoSQL databases provide flexible schemas for unstructured data. SQL is the standard language for querying relational databases. Database indexing improves query performance by creating data structures that allow faster lookups.
